law_name: Data Protection Act (Act No. 502 of 23 May 2018)
key_requirements: GDPR applies: lawful basis, data subject rights, breach notification
deceased_data: Act and GDPR apply to data of deceased persons for 10 years after death; may be changed by ministerial order (s. 2(5))
research_exemption: Sensitive data may be processed without consent solely for scientific or statistical purposes of significant societal importance (s. 10 'forskerhjemlen')
genetic_data: GDPR art. 9 special category; extra conditions on genetic, biometric and health data in Act on Research Ethics Review of Health Research Projects
